text: People of the valley, hear me.
For seven years the tower has stood silent above our homes.
Tonight its lights have woken, and the monsters walk the roads again.
I ask no one to be brave alone. I ask every one of you to stand together.
Close your doors, light your lamps, and wait for the dawn. The hero is already climbing.
speaker: Ryan
style: a proud old king, slow and solemn, speaking to a crowd
